animations.name: strong kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One powerful strong kick from standing guard to full extension. Pivot cleanly on the planted supporting foot, lean the torso forward-left while opening both arms wide with hands open for agile balance, and whip a crisp powerful horizontal high kick straight to the right into the exact final pose, preserving her long brown hair. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the ground contact anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
